theorems.name: Submission.dmcbr_ci_gp_density_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (t : ℝ≥0∞), (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)) ≤ (unitBallVolume n / 2 ^ n) • (μH[(n : ℝ)] : Measure (Euclid P)) → 0 < t → (∀ x ∈ A, t < limsup (fun r : ℝ => μ (closedBall x r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → t * μHE[n] A ≤ μ univ
